description: Feather is modern, intuitive, convention based, mobile-first UI for Sitefinity CMS™. This NuGet package does not have dependencies on any Sitefinity CMS™ related NuGet packages and thus it is expected that the core Sitefinity CMS™ packages are already installed in your project. Note that this NuGet package can be installed only on Sitefinity CMS™ web application projects.
title: Progress.Sitefinity.Feather
